subject: [PATCH v9 24/32] mm/madvise: keep PMD swap entries whole for MADV_GUARD_INSTALL/REMOVE

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch modifies the MADV_GUARD_INSTALL/REMOVE callbacks in the Linux kernel to treat PMD swap entries as whole, rather than splitting them. This change ensures that these operations do not attempt to split a swapped-out huge page, which would demote it before attempting to remove the guard pages. The patch addresses an issue where the existing code was incorrectly handling PMD swap entries and causing unnecessary work.
